text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—Right now, I'm running all alone.
None of my rivals from back then—are here.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Still... as long as this heart, these legs!
continue to harbor that burning passion from back then—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you
forget about us!
HAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...! Heart's speed is un...freakin'...believable...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, that vibe...
It reminds me of Craft.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ――! For sure! Craft had absolute speed too, didn't he!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! And Messiah chasing after her
with that incredible intensity!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: And! That's when Cesario came charging in...! Even watching from the stands, that finishing kick was terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Those days were... so thrilling!
Everyone's individuality and passion clashing together!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! When Craft and the others
decided to go for the NHK Mile Cup!
Man, I was so hyped for that too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, why on earth...
had I forgotten about it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That time was truly so full of passion.
Even now, it's so vivid I can still remember it clearly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Heart! Congratulations~~!"
"Thank you for continuing to run...!!"
"Heart...! Carry our dreams with you too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right, everyone—watch me!
Watch the path I'm about to take...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Did you feel that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Our... my passion...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Such an honest person.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —As I thought, let's take this path.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Those days I loved so dearly――
I will carry them forward... with these very legs.
choice_data_list: So you're going to keep your youth going, huh.
So you're going to keep your youth going, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
My rival this time is—myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Always face yourself and forge your own strength.
Survive—and preserve... those cherished days of youth.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
About our next goal...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My mind is already made up.
...Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That wasâthe stage promised for our showdown with Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes. A lot of titans of the mile division will be competing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's going to be a tough battle as usual!
So in order to win—
choice_data_list: I need to get yet another step stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no back to chase like there used to be...
Which is exactly why, so that my resolve doesn't waver—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
More and more, I must sharpen this heart—
this weapon of mine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For that sake...
I need to have a proper talk with her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, Tact.
I have to decline coaching you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I will keep on running.
...Until this heart shatters into pieces.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And such a day will never come.
Because you are strong...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Thank you for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You're not surprised, are you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...I had a feeling that was the case, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you in races...
I honestly could never have imagined you
transitioning into a coaching role."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's how brightly Heart-san's youth...
was shining. But...
I decided to take a gamble on it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Tact, you really are...
quite bold!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...To be honest, there are probably plenty of other ways to coach them, like training alongside them, but..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I bet... it'd just make me go soft, you know?
I'd start getting complacent, thinking I have other options.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You can't run this path with a lax mindset.
It's just like surviving in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You intend to push yourself
and walk the path of solitude, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I must venture to ask.
—Are you not lonely?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Because—I'm not alone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Things that are connected forever—through running.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Besides......—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
—You are not alone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: She understood perfectly.
choice_data_list: I see. That's a relief. ...Well then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...I'm heading to the next place."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Unya?
...Mr. Heart?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt your downtime.
...There's something I need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Would you come watch the Mile Championship?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...But I'm not in races anymore—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's not for your sake.
...I want you to come for mine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's always been like that, hasn't it?
I'm always the one chasing after you...
and I'm the one who's completely smitten with you, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I know it's just unrequited love on my part.
That's why I'll turn your head by force."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I shall reignite that flame within you.
—As your greatest rival.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft.
—I will not let it end here."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your hoofprints, your name...
and our youth together—I swear I'll keep etching them into history.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You definitely have to come watch, okay?
—It's a promise."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san chose a different path
from the rest of us, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "We... on the path we couldn't take..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...She really...
never changes, does she?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With that strong heart—
she pulls us all forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the 'Mile CS' with steely resolve.
Will Daring Heart's feelings reach her—
